name: cauldron
description: Cauldron in your terminal — generate images, search your Library, read brand kits, and upscale, extend, resize, or cut out images, upload your own files, import folders from Dropbox, and manage brand and studio settings over the Cauldron MCP. 28 tools scoped to your user + studio. Sign in with your Cauldron account, no key to paste. Ships skills covering the user docs, migrations, model choice, brand scoping, reference images, prompt craft, and the spend rules, so generations land in the right Library with the right kit applied instead of defaulting to Personal.
